items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: Woody Dennis told me, he just married his girl

ctx.x: Woody Dennis told me, he just married his girl and Lenny was always telling the guy that any girl -- girls would want to ball everybody in the band. And so he say, started telling him, Lee, put your head down by her foot, (inaudible), put your arms around her here. He couldn't see the things he was telling to do, making all this -- so Woody said, you're crazy, man, this is my wife. He said, all women aren't like you think they are, and walked out. And they weren't friends for a long time.
Very strange man. Getting back to composing. That to you, of all the three, is the thing that most interests you, and that's been the case --
